typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		DAYS_SUPPLY as integer,
		CLAIM_ID as string,
		REFILLS_REMAINING as string,
		PRODUCT_FLAG as string,
		REFILL_NUMBER as integer,
		PRESCRIBING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		PARMACY_NPI as string,
		NDC_CODE as string,
		PHARMACY_PART_B_D as string,
		GENERIC_INDICATOR as string,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER as string,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUMBER as string,
		FILL_DATE as string,
		PLAN_PAID_AMOUNT as string,
		UNITS as string,
		PATIENT_PAID_AMOUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DAYS_SUPPLY,
		CLAIM_ID,
		REFILLS_REMAINING,
		PRODUCT_FLAG,
		REFILL_NUMBER,
		PRESCRIBING_PROVIDER_NPI,
		PARMACY_NPI,
		NDC_CODE,
		PHARMACY_PART_B_D,
		GENERIC_INDICATOR,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUMBER,
		FILL_DATE,
		PLAN_PAID_AMOUNT,
		UNITS,
		PATIENT_PAID_AMOUNT)) ~> FlatFileDestination
